IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected from api-gateway cluster west-1. 5m error rate > 8% (baseline <0.5%). Triggered at 2855554321. Auto-pager engaged.
maya: I'm on pager. seeing a lot of 502/504 and some 429s in front of model-serving. Can folks avoid deploys for now? :exclamation:
raj: pulling logs from gateway and rate-limiter now. I see bursts of 429s for tenant=partnerX followed by downstream 5xx from model-proxy (timeout). Looks like quota throttling then overload retry storm.
sophie: confirming — metrics show per-tenant token bucket config for partnerX was changed ~10m before spike (policy service). New global cap accidentally applied: "global_qps: 50" for a high-concurrency tenant. That produced many 429s and a lot of client retry backlog. We also see model-proxy getting long tail latencies (KV cache churn).
leo: customer-ops reporting impact for a handful of customers (chat sessions failing). ETA to customer impact summary in 10m.
maya: mitigation plan: 1) revert quota change (sophie) 2) enable fallback routing to dedicated pool for critical tenants (raj) 3) enable short-term circuit-breaker to drop heavy requests to model-proxy (maya) 4) notify CS (leo) and escalate if not resolved in 15m.
sophie: rolling back policy now. command:
```
policyctl revert --id=policy/2026-03-15/tenant-qos --reason="investigation: misapply"
```
sophie: rollback applied at 2855554750. Waiting for policy propagation to gateways (~30s-2m).
raj: preemptively opening route to dedicated pool for partnerX:
```
routingctl set-route --tenant partnerX --pool dedicated-west-1 --mode immediate
```
raj: routed at 2855554815. Observability: gateway 429s dropping from ~1400/s to ~300/s; model-proxy 5xx rate trending down.
maya: enabling circuit-breaker on model-proxy for requests with >8s expected runtime to protect core path. config snippet:
```
model-proxy.circuit_breaker: {
  max_concurrent: 120,
  request_timeout_ms: 8000,
  error_threshold_pct: 10
}
```
maya: cb enabled at 2855554880. Immediate reduction in queued tasks.
leo: sending interim customer note: "We're investigating elevated errors affecting some sessions. Engineers are actively mitigating — we'll share updates in 15m." (sent)
pagerduty: Paging escalation to oncall-sre if not resolved by 2855555721.
sophie: correlation: I also see a spike of retries from our client-side SDK for partnerX — retry-backoff jitter is low. We should throttle client retries server-side until stable.
raj: applied adaptive-retry gate on gateway to add exponential backoff headers to 429 responses. patch id: gw-2871. Deployed at 2855555030.
maya: metrics check: last 4m 5xx reduced from 8% -> 0.9%. 429s for partnerX back to expected QPS. Latency p95 for model-proxy improving. System health trending green.
leo: customer-ops update: sent follow-up acknowledging fix and offering to escalate if they still see issues. No major SLA breaches detected so far, but a few user-visible errors for ~6 minutes.
sophie: root cause: policy rollout pipeline applied a per-tenant cap using the wrong selector (applied global override). We'll open a postmortem and fix gating on policy pushes.
maya: immediate actions recap:
- rollback policy (done)
- route high-traffic tenants to dedicated pool (done)
- enable circuit-breaker (done)
- add gateway adaptive-retry (done)
- CS notified (leo)
- monitor 30m then close if stable

maya: assigning follow-ups:
- sophie -> postmortem + revert test (owner)
- raj -> hardening routing automation tests
- leo -> customer incident summary + any credits if needed

sophie: filing postmortem ticket: PM-INC-2026-03-15-01. I'll include timeline and policy pipeline fix.
raj: adding smoke tests for policy pushes to staging / gating step.
maya: marking incident as mitigated at 2855556500. I'll stay on call for the next 30m for any regression. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Incident mitigated by maya at 2855556500. Initial severity: P1. Duration: ~7m 39s. Notifications: #incidents, pagerduty, customer-ops.
leo: final customer note drafted and queued. Will send after 30m verification.
maya: closing thread for now; reopen if errors spike again. Thanks team. :heartpulse:
